# Conference

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A board conference with its message areas, file directories, doors and access checks.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#board-objects-400).

## AllowAliases

`Conference.AllowAliases: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only conference behavior and messaging policy.

## Areas

`Conference.Areas: Area[]`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only one-dimensional snapshot of this conference's file directories, message areas, doors, bulletins, or surveys.

## IntroFile

`Conference.IntroFile: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Configured conference introduction display-file path, or an empty string when none is configured. Check HasAccess() before using DISPFILE; reading this property does not display or read the file.

## NewsFile

`Conference.NewsFile: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Configured news display-file path, or an empty string when none is configured. Check the conference's HasAccess() before using DISPFILE; reading this property does not read the file.

Read-only instance property.
